rows.title: The performance suite's INS readiness probe follows the INS home's heading
rows.detail: The performance suite waits for the stack to be ready by reading the INS home and the address book. Its INS probe matches the home's main heading exactly, so it must change in the same increment that renames the home's heading to 'Import notification service': changed first it breaks every performance run on main, changed late every run's readiness fails after five minutes. The home's heading change waits until the front door dashboard's requirements are firmed up, so this probe change waits with it.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'INS signed-in page' readiness probe passes when the INS home answers 200 to a signed-in request with the main heading 'Import notification service' (repo:perftests src/k6/readiness.js; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-075, p3-076)

The 'address book read' readiness probe passes when the front door's address book answers 200 with the heading 'Address book' (repo:perftests src/k6/readiness.js; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-075)

The stack counts as functionally ready only when one pass succeeds for all six readiness probes, and readiness otherwise fails after 300 seconds naming the probes that failed (repo:perftests src/k6/readiness.js; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-076)
openQuestions: Blocked: the probe matches the INS home's heading exactly (c-146), so it changes only in the increment that changes that heading, and that increment is blocked until the front door dashboard's requirements firm up and are agreed (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 52). Who: whoever owns the front door dashboard's requirements must firm them up and agree them with Sam.
rows.notes: Already sits in inc-128, the overall INS home, with req-1848's other performance-suite checks of the same heading; keep it there so the probe and the heading land together and the performance suite is never broken on main. This draft adds nothing to that row's three readiness criteria: the combiner should merge it in, not keep a second row. The probe itself lives in perftests src/k6/readiness.js, which no split-off theme touches; the heading it follows lives in the INS dashboard feature folder, which the split-off type-question-and-templates theme owns, but that change belongs to inc-128's other requirements, which were in the row before the split.

rows.title: Germinal products pages carry the shared service chrome, with home links inside the germinal set
rows.detail: A trader moving between the live animals and germinal products sets must see one service. Every germinal products page carries the same service navigation, phase banner, footer, browser title pattern, section captions, back links, error summary and banners as a live animals page, and the service name and Dashboard item lead to the germinal set's own root, which shows that set's notification list. The shared layout already resolves the home link, the current item and the error page's chrome per set by the longest mount prefix a path starts with, so this needs no shared layout change: the set only has to be mounted and configured.
acceptanceCriteria: Every germinal products page shows the 'Import notification service' service navigation with the same items, in the same order, as a live animals page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-009; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-009)
Every germinal products page shows the Alpha phase banner with its feedback link, and the footer, as live animals pages do (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006)

Every germinal products page's browser title reads '<page title> - Import notification service - GOV.UK', with 'Error: ' in front when the page shows validation errors (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006)

Germinal products journey pages show the same section captions, back links, error summary and banners as the live animals page each one is copied from (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, -p1-011)

On every germinal products page the service name and the Dashboard navigation item link to the germinal products set's own root at /germinal-products, and following either one shows the germinal products notification list (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-008; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-103, -p3-104; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-021, -p1-022; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-013, repo-frontend-p2-128)

Dashboard is the current navigation item at the germinal products set's root and on every page inside a germinal products notification (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-009; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011)

Opening an address under /germinal-products that does not exist shows 'Page not found' in the germinal set's chrome, with the service name linking to /germinal-products (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-131, repo-frontend-p2-132; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p13-058)

Opening an address that falls under no set shows 'Page not found' with the service name linking to the service root (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-156; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p13-058)
rows.notes: Already sits in inc-176, the germinal products set's first row, which combines five areas' drafts; this draft restates its chrome criteria and adds the set-free error page criterion from req-1907's last sentence, so the combiner should merge it into inc-176 rather than keep a second row. c-314 overrules the morning ruling's redirect of a set root to another service's list, so the root shows the germinal list itself, copied from the live animals list on main today (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 p1-021, p1-022). The shared layout under frontend src/server/app/shared already resolves chrome per set and is read, not changed; that folder is the split-off journey-foundation theme's, so if the plan finds it must change, that change belongs on that branch and this row consumes it.
